[2] «Renny Harlin | Renny Harlin (born Lauri Mauritz Harjola; 15 March 1959) is a Finnish film director, producer and screenwriter.  His films include "", "Die Hard 2", "Cliffhanger", "The Long Kiss Goodnight," "Deep Blue Sea and Driven."»

Jackson as McClane's reluctant partner Zeus Carver, and Jeremy Irons as Simon Gruber.  It was released on May 19, 1995, five years after "Die Hard 2", becoming the highest-grossing film at the worldwide box-office that year, but received mixed reviews.
